title: Food, Health and Product Integrity Code Consolidation
jurisdiction: India; Union food, health and product-safety framework with State implementation interfaces
source_or_instruction: User requested consolidation and severe, safeguarded accountability for deliberate mass-harm food adulteration.
notes: In progress and not ready for introduction. A consolidated 116-section working Bill, Indian-law research pack, provenance ledger, power map, democratic-impact monitor, public-deliberation plan and validation records were created on 2026-08-16. An official FSSAI/Parliament procedure source update, a discrete FSS recycled-PET amendment/repeal schedule and a 116-clause legal-vehicle allocation are recorded in 02-legal-review. On 2026-08-16, a targeted exact-text draft amendment of BNS section 274 was added to require a two-year minimum and five-year maximum term for the existing intentional food-adulteration offence; BNS section 275 was not altered. Exact primary-source amendment schedules for the remaining clauses, State/UT verification, competence, fiscal, judicial-treatment and formal-readiness gates remain open.
